head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: Known-ledger entries for internal/server (code-style NIT-1..NIT-43, NIT-166..174, r2 NIT-18..26) were not re-reported. Pervasive repo idioms (xxxErr error names, nested-call single-line require.NoError(os.WriteFile(...)) in tests, scattered const blocks in routines.go) treated as legacy per the go.md ENFORCEMENT clause. Cross-chunk: config.LoadFragment / config.ExpandInstallMarkers, repos.Fingerprint / repos.WorktreeKindCount, peek.SessionIndex and sessions archive APIs live outside this chunk and were not verified here.

findings.fix:
Break the call one argument per line: content := fmt.Sprintf(
	"---
language: %s
audience: %s
dev-mode: %t
---
%s",
	language,
	audience,
	devMode,
	body,
)
findings.claim: New saveProfileSelection builds the profile file with a single-line fmt.Sprintf carrying 5 arguments (format, language, audience, devMode, body); RULE-GOLANG-CALL-001 requires a multiline call at 5 or more arguments.
findings.evidence: Re-read presentation.go:88-112 at 1f725ce (git grep confirms line 105). The line is added in this diff (presentation.go was rewritten from the profile-only loader). Argument count is exactly 5. Not covered by the known ledger: known CALL-001 rows are bootstrap.go:82 (NIT-14), profilesettings.go:147 (NIT-9), overview.go:458 (NIT-17), proposals.go:181/453 (NIT-24-r2, NIT-27) — none cover presentation.go.

findings.fix:
Break the timing log call one argument per line: log.Printf(
	"timing: repo=%s %s rows=%d cached=%t",
	repo.Name,
	formatTimings(data.Timings),
	len(statuses),
	data.Cached,
)
findings.claim: The changed handleRepoWorktreeStatus timing log grew a fifth argument (data.Cached) and still sits on one line with two nested calls (formatTimings, len); RULE-GOLANG-CALL-001 requires a multiline call at 5 or more arguments or any nested-call argument.
findings.evidence: Re-read repos.go:352-421 at 1f725ce; the diff changes line 419 from a 4-argument log.Printf to the 5-argument form with cached=%t. git grep confirms the committed line number 419. Known ledger rows for repos.go (NIT-1 L174, NIT-2 L583, NIT-3 L320, NIT-37 L586, MAJ-7, BLK-54, tests rows) do not cover this call.

findings.fix: Rename the class on the archive form (e.g. class="archive-form", or a neutral spacing class shared with _worktree_status.html's Reload row) and rename the .reload-form rule in style.css to match.
findings.claim: The diff deletes the sessions 'Reload from disk' form (POST /sessions/reload, handleSessionsReload) but hands its class name reload-form to the new 'Archive folder' form, so the markup names an archive control as a reload form.
findings.evidence: Re-read sessions_index.html:13-29 at 1f725ce and the base: at b4981b8 sessions_index.html:16 was <form hx-post="/sessions/reload" ... class="reload-form">; at 1f725ce line 20 is <form class="reload-form" hx-post="/sessions/{{pathEscape .Scope.Name}}/archive" ...> with an 'Archive folder' button. The only other reload-form user, _worktree_status.html:27, wraps the new Reload button (name fits there). style.css:354 .reload-form only sets margin-bottom. No known-ledger row covers sessions_index.html.
